raw_tokens.value: Bounty Hunter Class Feature.Slayer Class Feature.SpecialQuality.Extraordinary

When a bounty hunter attempts a grapple combat maneuver check to deal damage, he can choose to add his sneak attack damage to the grapple damage for that attack. He takes a -5 penalty on the combat maneuver check if he does this. This sneak attack damage is nonlethal damage, unless the bounty hunter is able to deal normal damage with a grapple and chooses to do so.
